about_the_game: A short demo of Minigames Mayhem shows off games you can enjoy solo or with your friends. Try out the maps and games and fall in love with it!

content_descriptors.notes: General Mature content is in-game such as cartoon violence

detailed_description: A short demo of Minigames Mayhem shows off games you can enjoy solo or with your friends. Try out the maps and games and fall in love with it!
name: Minigames Mayhem Demo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750-Ti / AMD RX 550, 2GB VRam
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Soundcard
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 7500K / AMD equivalent
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580, 4GB VRam / Intel Arc A380
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Minigames Mayhem is a fun collection of minigames, that can bring joy for players not only in single-player but also with friends in your living room or across vast distances. Try to beat the high scores, compete with others, and bring mayhem on other players in many simple but fun games!
supported_languages:
English*, French*, Italian*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Portuguese - Portugal*, Polish*, Simplified Chinese*, Czech*
*languages with full audio support
